name: year
description: Reference year of the index value

name: annual_change_percent
description: Percentage change in the index from the previous year
observations: Null in the first year of each series, which has no previous year

name: index_nsa
description: Annual house price index, not seasonally adjusted, with the first year of the series set to 100

name: index_nsa_1990_base
description: Annual house price index rescaled so that 1990 equals 100
observations: Null where the series does not reach 1990

name: index_nsa_2000_base
description: Annual house price index rescaled so that 2000 equals 100
observations: Null where the series does not reach 2000
